verdict.rationale: Workable offers AI-generated candidate recommendations and matching against job ads (docs-9, docs-24), AI-powered candidate search (docs-8), and a Workable Agent that sources, screens, and qualifies candidates producing an interview-ready shortlist (docs-15) — all surfacing AI-driven insights/suggestions from recruiting data inside the product. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of insight quality, and no evidence of broader analytics/report-level AI insights (e.g., pipeline analytics narratives) beyond candidate sourcing.
